src:
Doctor: Hello, Mrs. Johnson. How have you been feeling since starting the new medication, Lisinopril?
Patient: Well, doctor, I've noticed my blood pressure has improved, but I've been experiencing some dry cough...

Doctor: Good morning, Mr. Smith. I see you're here for a follow-up on your Metformin prescription.
Patient: Yes, doctor. I've been taking it regularly, but I'm concerned about some side effects I've been experiencing...

Doctor: Hi Ms. Lee, I understand you started taking Atorvastatin last month. How are you feeling?
Patient: Overall I'm okay, but I’ve noticed some muscle soreness lately...

Doctor: Good afternoon, Mr. Ramirez. Have you noticed any changes since beginning your Omeprazole treatment?
Patient: Actually yes, the heartburn is better, but I’ve been feeling a bit bloated...

Doctor: Hello, Mrs. Patel. Are you still taking the Sertraline as prescribed?
Patient: Yes, doctor. It’s helping with my mood, but I’ve had trouble sleeping sometimes...

Doctor: Hi Mr. Thompson, you're here for your inhaler check-up. How has the Albuterol been working for you?
Patient: It helps during flare-ups, but I've been using it more often lately...

Doctor: Good morning, Ms. Nguyen. Since starting Levothyroxine, have you noticed improvements in your energy levels?
Patient: A little, but I've also had some heart palpitations...

Doctor: Hello, Mr. Carter. How are you doing with the new Warfarin dosage?
Patient: I think it's working, but I've been bruising more easily...

Doctor: Hi Mrs. Wilson, I see you began taking Hydrochlorothiazide recently. Any side effects?
Patient: Yes, doctor. My swelling is down, but I’ve been feeling dehydrated...

Doctor: Good afternoon, Mr. Alvarez. You’re here to discuss your new insulin regimen. How is it going?
Patient: It’s helping control my sugar levels, but I'm worried about occasional dizziness...

Doctor: Hello, Ms. Hernandez. How have you been tolerating the new Fluoxetine dose?
Patient: It's helping with my anxiety, but I've been feeling a bit nauseous in the mornings...

Doctor: Good morning, Mrs. Green. I see you started using the new asthma controller medication. Any concerns so far?
Patient: Yes, doctor. My breathing is better, but I've developed a mild sore throat...
